text:
tyler: Heads-up: EU canary users reporting slow dashboard loads and stuttering sparklines after last deploy. Heatmaps and metric panels seem worst. Anyone on-call can check traces? :eyes:

nina: I'm seeing LCP regression in canary with matching flame charts. Main thread parse+eval time jumped. Heatmap init stalls around a sync import.

omar: looked at bundle diffs  telemetry-sampler added `pako` and a sync inflate path. telemetry chunk grew ~350KB. Also notice prefetch routing TTL dropped from 28s -> 6s in the recent routing tweak. That likely increases KV eviction and tile cold-fetches.

sophia: flame snippet: 
```
MainThread: HTMLParse 90ms -> Eval main 140ms -> TelemetrySampler.init (sync) 170ms -> ChartLib.eval 40ms
KV miss rate: 48% (was ~12%) -> tile requests up 2.4x
```

tyler: ok that's the combo: heavier sync telemetry + aggressive prefetch TTL = cold cache + blocked eval. We should rollback the telemetry change in canary or lazy-load it immediately.

nina: quick mitigation idea: wrap telemetry init with requestIdleCallback + dynamic import so it won't block initial parse. e.g.:
```
if ('requestIdleCallback' in window) {
  requestIdleCallback(()=>import('./telemetry-sampler').then(m=>m.init()))
} else {
  setTimeout(()=>import('./telemetry-sampler').then(m=>m.init()), 2000)
}
```
This keeps sampling warm without hurting LCP.

omar: I'll revert the prefetch TTL to 20s for eu-canary to reduce KV churn. Also will open a PR to lazy-load pako and the sync path.

sophia: can we also add a temporary bundle-size gate in CI and an alert for >200KB chunk growth? Might have prevented this surprise.

tyler: yes, add a bump alert and a budget. Immediate plan: 1) revert telemetry sync change in canary OR apply lazy-load patch 2) revert EU prefetch TTL to 20s 3) add bundle-size CI warning 4) follow-up: feature-flag telemetry + server-side decompress option.

ci-bot: NOTE: canary rollback window open until 6225001280. Please open rollback PRs before that timestamp to trigger automated rollback.

nina: opened PR #3701 for lazy-load + requestIdleCallback. If rollback happens we'll revert the pako addition.

omar: eu-canary TTL revert applied to config. Posting perf diffs in 15m.

tyler: thanks all. After we have diffs let's decide permanent telemetry rollout strategy. :thumbsup:
